summary: The recorded base reproduces the original recorder pass-end GPU-to-host synchronization failure during real gfx950 graph capture. The exact candidate skips only recorder pass-boundary bookkeeping during capture, passes its regression tests, and passes an independent adversarial GPU test showing that layer-hook device work remains captured and executes on replay. No candidate source counterexample was found.

tests.what_was_measured: A real HIP graph capture entered _on_forward_pass_end and failed at Tensor.item() with hipErrorStreamCaptureUnsupported, matching the reported failure boundary. See raw/base_minimal_capture.log.

Four candidate regression/boundary tests passed: capture suppresses pass boundaries, eager recording preserves them, disabled recording remains inert, and hooks remain active during capture. See raw/candidate_unit.log.
The candidate author's real gfx950 capture fixture completed without entering the forbidden pass-end synchronization. See raw/candidate_author_gpu.log.

Independent adversarial real-GPU check: reset/collect/append calls remained zero during capture, while a layer-hook add was recorded and one replay changed the device buffer from the independent expected 0.0 to 3.0. See raw/candidate_independent_contract.log.
The exact candidate diff has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: Tests used the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, with PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. Source imports resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang. See raw/imports_gpu.log.

remaining_limitations: The production architecture was NVIDIA B200 CUDA, while review execution used AMD MI355X gfx950 HIP. Both expose the same stream-capture prohibition and the exact failing Tensor.item() boundary was reproduced, but NVIDIA-specific runtime behavior was not executed.

GLM-5.2 NVFP4 weights, its built-in MTP draft layer, and an 8-GPU TP8 environment were unavailable. No full model, server startup, semantic-accuracy, or distributed-collective reproduction was claimed.
The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture cannot qualify the reported MoE/MTP architecture and was therefore not substituted as proof.
No native source changed in the candidate, repository-environment.json declares no native artifact, and no native rebuild was applicable.
